Name: Emergency stop sim
System_Reaction: Stop all pump commands and go to FAULT
Operator_Action: Check area then release E-stop and reset

Name: Source low
Condition: DI_Source_Low = TRUE or source level < 15 percent
Reset: Source level OK and Reset if latched
HMI_Text: SOURCE LEVEL LOW: DRY RUN RISK

Name: Tank level critical high
System_Reaction: Stop all pumps and raise critical alarm
Reset: Level below high threshold and Reset
HMI_Text: TANK LEVEL CRITICAL HIGH: OVERFLOW RISK
Probable_Causes: Pump not stopped at high level or level sensor drift
Operator_Action: Check level sensor and stop logic, check consumption

Name: Low flow P1
Condition: P1 running and validation delay elapsed and flow < 2 m3/h
System_Reaction: P1 unavailable and P2 allowed if available
Probable_Causes: Closed valve or clogged filter or leak or dry run or sensor fault
Operator_Action: Check valves and filter, inspect pump 1

Name: Low flow P2
Condition: P2 running and validation delay elapsed and flow < 2 m3/h
System_Reaction: P2 unavailable and P1 allowed if available
Probable_Causes: Closed valve or clogged filter or leak or dry run or sensor fault
Operator_Action: Check valves and filter, inspect pump 2

Name: Pump 1 fault
Condition: DI_P1_Fault = FALSE (NC contact) or no run feedback within 5 s after run command
Probable_Causes: Motor protection tripped or contactor failure or overload or wire break
Operator_Action: Inspect pump 1, contactor and motor protection

Name: Pump 2 fault
Condition: DI_P2_Fault = FALSE (NC contact) or no run feedback within 5 s after run command
Probable_Causes: Motor protection tripped or contactor failure or overload or wire break
Operator_Action: Inspect pump 2, contactor and motor protection

Name: Inconsistent sensor
Condition: Value out of range or below 4 mA or physically impossible
System_Reaction: Warning or Fault depending on severity
Probable_Causes: Wire break or sensor failure or scaling error

Name: No pump available
Condition: Pumping demand and P1 and P2 unavailable
Probable_Causes: Both pumps faulted or low flow on both
Operator_Action: Repair at least one pump then reset

Name: Frequent starts
Probable_Causes: Tight thresholds or leak or small tank
Operator_Action: Review thresholds and check for leaks
